title: 第7章 一个女儿控，一个姐控，一个妹控
slug: 狗哥你再舔女主我就和黄毛私奔
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“爸。”

只听赵楹月轻声细语的喊了声。

闻言，赵随野的眼皮跳的更快了，手指捏的‘咯吱’响。

没料到她竟会直接给父亲打电话。

他试图用警告的眼神警告赵楹月，可对方压根看都不看他一眼。

赵随野：“……”

该死的黄毛！

心中又狠狠记了一笔。

“月月？”赵父的声音透过听筒传来，“怎么想到给爸爸打电话了？”

“是不是赵随野那臭小子欺负你？”

“不是，”赵楹月否认，她的目的可不是告状，“我想去哥哥的公司上班。”

一句话，让正在晒日光浴的赵父，一个鲤鱼打挺的从沙滩椅坐起。

脸上敷的东西也随之落下。

“月月，怎么突然想到去上班了？你要是缺钱用，就和你哥说，不用辛苦当牛马，我们赵家养得起你。”

赵楹月支支吾吾，没敢说缘由。

只是坚持，“爸，我就要去哥哥的公司上班。”

赵父心中本就对赵楹月有愧。

即便是女儿要天上的星星，他都要想办法去摘。

如今只是想上班，那更要满足了。

当即连声答应，“行行行，爸同意了，回头就让她给你安排一个轻松的职位。”

“你也别太累，每天吃吃零食，追追剧就行了……”

赵父将赵楹月上班的行程，规划的明明白白。

赵楹月感动。

不愧是她亲爹啊！

简直太懂她了！

等赵父说完，赵楹月还没挂电话。

赵随野突然有一种不好的预感。

果然——

“爸，哥让孟以棠也去公司了。”

赵父稍微思索一番，便记起这号人物来，“是小棠啊。”

“哥给我开三万工资，要给孟以棠开三百万，他偏心。”

赵楹月控诉开口，似乎真的很委屈。

那头拔高声音，恼怒咆哮：“什么？三百万？什么岗位一个月三百万？你哥呢？给老子叫过来！”

耳听全部的赵随野：“……”

他什么时候说要给孟以棠开三百万了？

明明是妹妹你，为了一个出轨的黄毛，狮子大开口要两百万！

不气不气。

他就赵楹月这一个亲妹妹。

真把自己气死了，那黄毛还不得笑掉大牙？

赵随野给自己反复做着心理工作。

Page (1/3)

"Dad."

Only Zhao Yingyue shouted softly.

Hearing this, Zhao Suiye's eyelids jumped faster, and his fingers made a "squeaking" sound.

Unexpectedly, she would call her father directly.

He tried to warn Zhao Yingyue with warning eyes, but the other party didn't even look at him.

Zhao Suiye: "..."

Damn yellow hair!

Another serious note was made in my heart.

"Yueyue?" Father Zhao's voice came through the receiver, "Why did you think of calling daddy?"

"Did that brat Zhao Suiye bully you?"

"No," Zhao Yingyue denied. Her purpose was not to file a complaint. "I want to work in my brother's company."

One sentence made Father Zhao, who was sunbathing, sit up from the beach chair like a carp.

The things on his face also fell off.

"Yueyue, why did you suddenly think of going to work? If you are short of money, just tell your brother that you don't have to work hard as a cow or horse, our Zhao family can afford to support you."

Zhao Yingyue hesitated, not daring to say the reason.

Just insist, "Dad, I'm going to work in my brother's company."

Father Zhao felt guilty towards Zhao Yingyue.

Even if his daughter wants the stars in the sky, he will find a way to pick them up.

Now I just want to go to work, which is even more satisfying.

He immediately agreed, "Okay, okay, Dad agrees. I'll ask her to arrange a relaxed position for you later."

"Don't be too tired. Just eat snacks every day and catch up on TV dramas..."

Father Zhao clearly planned Zhao Yingyue's schedule for work.

Zhao Yingyue was moved.

He is indeed her biological father!

I understand her so well!

By the time Father Zhao finished speaking, Zhao Yingyue hadn't hung up the phone yet.

Zhao Suiye suddenly had a bad feeling.

Sure enough——

"Dad, I asked Meng Yitang to go to the company too."

Father Zhao thought for a moment and then remembered this person, "It's Xiaotang."

"Brother offered me a salary of 30,000 yuan and wanted to give Meng Yitang 3 million. He is partial."

Zhao Yingyue complained, seeming really aggrieved.

The other end raised his voice and roared angrily: "What? Three million? What position costs three million a month? Where is your brother? Call me here!"

Zhao Suiye, who heard everything: "..."

When did he say he would give Meng Yitang three million?

It's obviously you, my sister, but for a cheating yellow guy, the lion is asking for two million!

Not angry or angry.

He is Zhao Yingyue's biological sister.

If you really piss yourself off, then Huang Mao can't help but laugh out loud?

Zhao Suiye repeatedly did psychological work for himself.
